mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_agent_presence p JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.id = p.agent_id JOIN fcc_call_session c ON c.id = #{callId} AND c.primary_work_no = a.work_no SET p.work_status = 'READY', p.last_state_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), p.version = p.version + 1 WHERE a.work_no = #{owner} AND p.work_status = 'ACW' AND p.active_call_id IS NULL AND c.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fcc_call_session newer WHERE newer.primary_work_no = #{owner} AND newer.id != c.id AND newer.started_at > c.started_at )
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.work_no AS workNo, b.endpoint_type AS endpointType, b.endpoint_value AS extension FROM fcc_agent a JOIN fcc_agent_endpoint_binding b ON b.agent_id = a.id AND b.status = 'ENABLED' AND b.is_active = 1 JOIN fcc_extension e ON e.extension = b.endpoint_value AND e.endpoint_type = b.endpoint_type AND e.status = 'ENABLED' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE a.work_no = #{owner} AND a.status = 'ENABLED' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT a.id, a.work_no AS workNo, b.endpoint_type AS endpointType, b.endpoint_value AS extension FROM fcc_agent a JOIN fcc_agent_endpoint_binding b ON b.agent_id = a.id AND b.status = 'ENABLED' JOIN fcc_extension e ON e.extension = b.endpoint_value AND e.endpoint_type = b.endpoint_type AND e.status = 'ENABLED' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE b.endpoint_value = #{extension} AND b.endpoint_type IN ('WEBRTC', 'SIP') AND a.status = 'ENABLED' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY b.is_active DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO fcc_agent_presence(agent_id, login_status, work_status, last_state_at) SELECT id, 'ONLINE', 'REST', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM fcc_agent WHERE work_no = #{owner} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_agent_presence p JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.id = p.agent_id SET p.login_status = 'ONLINE', p.work_status = #{state}, p.last_state_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), p.version = p.version + 1 WHERE a.work_no = #{owner} AND p.active_call_id IS NULL AND a.status = 'ENABLED' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE fcc_agent_presence p JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.id = p.agent_id SET p.work_status = 'BUSY', p.active_call_id = #{callId}, p.last_state_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), p.version = p.version + 1 WHERE a.work_no = #{owner} AND p.login_status = 'ONLINE' AND p.work_status = 'READY' AND p.active_call_id IS NULL AND a.status = 'ENABLED' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE fcc_agent_presence p JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.id = p.agent_id SET p.login_status = 'ONLINE', p.work_status = 'BUSY', p.active_call_id = #{callId}, p.last_state_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), p.version = p.version + 1 WHERE a.work_no = #{owner} AND p.work_status IN ('READY', 'REST') AND p.active_call_id IS NULL AND a.status = 'ENABLED' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE fcc_agent_presence p JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.id = p.agent_id SET p.work_status = 'ACW', p.active_call_id = NULL, p.last_state_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), p.version = p.version + 1 WHERE a.work_no = #{owner} AND p.active_call_id = #{callId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.work_status AS status, CAST(p.active_call_id AS CHAR) AS callId FROM fcc_agent_presence p JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.id = p.agent_id WHERE a.work_no = #{owner}
SELECT n.phone_number AS caller, n.routing_context AS context FROM fcc_outbound_number n WHERE n.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND n.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fcc_extension WHERE extension = #{number} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, ctrl_id AS ctrlId, model_type AS modelType, direction, caller_number AS caller, destination_number AS destination, status, attributes FROM fcc_call_session WHERE id > #{after} AND ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 200

SELECT d.route_key AS routeKey, v.id AS versionId, v.definition_json AS definition FROM fcc_did_number d LEFT JOIN fcc_flow_definition f ON f.flow_key = d.route_key LEFT JOIN fcc_flow_definition_version v ON v.flow_definition_id = f.id AND v.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' WHERE d.phone_number = #{number} AND d.routing_context = #{context} AND d.status = 'ENABLED' AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY v.version_no DESC LIMIT 2

SELECT a.work_no AS workNo, b.endpoint_type AS endpointType, b.endpoint_value AS extension FROM fcc_agent a JOIN fcc_agent_presence p ON p.agent_id = a.id JOIN fcc_agent_group_member m ON m.agent_id = a.id JOIN fcc_agent_group g ON g.id = m.group_id JOIN fcc_agent_endpoint_binding b ON b.agent_id = a.id AND b.status = 'ENABLED' AND b.is_active = 1 JOIN fcc_extension e ON e.extension = b.endpoint_value AND e.endpoint_type = b.endpoint_type AND e.status = 'ENABLED' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE g.group_code = #{group} AND g.status = 'ENABLED' AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status = 'ENABLED' AND b.endpoint_type IN ('WEBRTC', 'SIP') AND p.login_status = 'ONLINE' AND p.work_status = 'READY' AND p.active_call_id IS NULL
AND a.work_no NOT IN
#{owner}
ORDER BY p.last_state_at, a.id LIMIT 1
